blocks.text:
After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to the Galápagos Islands.

On arrival at **Baltra** airport, your guide will meet you.

The drive to the **Itabaca** Channel takes about **10 minutes**.

After the crossing, your journey across Santa Cruz Island begins.

The first part of the route takes you through the highlands.

Here you will see **giant Galápagos tortoises in their natural habitat**. These animals have become one of the archipelago’s main symbols and gave the islands their familiar name.

During the tour, you can observe tortoises of different sizes and ages and learn about their habitat.

Galápagos finches and other birds can also be found in the highlands.

The programme mentions endemic plants and forests characteristic of the wetter part of the island.

On the way to Puerto Ayora, the landscape gradually changes from the dry areas of Baltra and northern Santa Cruz to the green highlands.

Lunch is included.

After the tour, transfer to Puerto Ayora.

Check in at **Fiesta 3***.

Free time after check-in. You can stroll along the waterfront and visit restaurants and souvenir shops.

**Meals:** breakfast and lunch.
